title: Case platform parameters
description: A case's platform parameters (case.json inputs.platform; MiSArch: cases/misarch/generator/platform.json, written by its platform.py): the middleware, infrastructure and cost constants core/generator/derive.py reads as S[...]. The required keys are the ones the core reads; a case's adapter may read more (MiSArch's: gateway, broker and Keycloak parameters).

hopCallerCpuMs.description: a remote call's CPU on the caller's sidecar (RemoteCalls.callerCpuMs)

hopCalleeCpuMs.description: a remote call's CPU on the callee's sidecar (RemoteCalls.calleeCpuMs)

gatewayFetchCpuMs.description: the entry's compose CPU of a joined field (ComposedCall.composeCpuMs)

cacheHitRatio.description: a cache's hit ratio where a site has none of its own

replicaReadDbMs.description: a local copy's read, database ms per statement

replicaReadCpuMs.description: a local copy's read, reader CPU

replicaWriteCpuMs.description: a local copy's update per delivered event, CPU

replicaWriteDbMs.description: a local copy's update, database ms

entityCacheHitCpuMs.description: the provider's entity cache (joinCache as built): its CPU per hit, receiving envelope included (ComposedCall.hitCpuMs; the cached operation's lookup is this minus the measured providers' receiving envelope, at least 0)

entityCacheMissCpuMs.description: the provider's entity cache: CPU per miss on top of the uncached call (ComposedCall.missCpuMs)

orchestratorStepCpuMs.description: an orchestrated saga's coordinator CPU per step (Orchestrated.stepCpuMs)

coresPerReplica.description: CPU per replica of an application container (Deployable.cpuPerReplica)
